description: Runs ASR models exported to ONNX through the onnx-asr library, without a PyTorch dependency. This fighter runs the stock OpenAI Whisper base checkpoint (whisper), an auto-detect multilingual encoder-decoder covering Turkish among its ~99 trained languages.
notes: Upstream onnx-asr export of openai/whisper-base (istupakov/whisper-base-onnx), listed as a supported model name in the onnx-asr README. Langs pinned to tr-TR, the language actually exercised against the speech-massive tr-TR intent dataset.
